1.consolidated_definition: Servicio completo. Sistema de venta empleado en algunas gasolineras en el que se dispone de empleados para dar los servicios. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Dicha orden limitaba su imposición a compras menores de $10 y aplicaba en estaciones que tuvieran servicio combinado, esto es, self service y full service (El Nuevo Día, 11- 09-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Full-service system. A sales system used in some gas stations where employees are available to provide services. Raw anglicism, commonly used. This order limited its imposition to purchases under $10 and applied to stations that had a combined service, i.e., self-service and full-service (The New Day, 11-09-06)
